question: In _________, the All India Kabaddi Federation came into existence and compiled standard rules.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1950.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The All-India Kabaddi Federation was established in 1950.
 
• It aimed to promote and organize Kabaddi at a national level.
 
• The federation started organizing national-level competitions, including the Senior National Championship from 1952.
 
• The federation compiled and standardized the rules of Kabaddi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Kabaddi is a contact team sport that originated in ancient India.
 
• There are seven players in a team.

 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 Term
 Description
 
 

 Raider
 The player who enters the opponent’s half to tag defenders and score points.
 
 

 Cant
 The continuous chant of “kabaddi” by the raider during the raid.
 
 

 Super Tackle
 A tackle executed by three or fewer defenders, earning the defending team an extra point.
 
 

 Do or Die Raid
 A raid where the raider must score a point; failing to do so results in the raider being out.
 
 

 All Out
 When all players of a team are out, the opposing team earns additional points and all players are revived.
 
 

 Bonus Line
 A line that, when crossed by the raider with at least one foot in the air, awards an extra point.
 
 

 Pursuit
 A move where a defender chases and attempts to tag the raider immediately after the raider has completed their raid.
